'''Chronicler''' was a position and title in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="Insider 147">{{InsiderCite|147|Rogues Gallery|Rogues Gallery: The Devious Neimoidians Revealed}}</ref><ref name="KOTOR">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref>

===Trade Federation===
In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], the [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[Writing|author]] [[Viff Almay]] was appointed official [[Timeline of galactic history/Legends|chronicler]] of the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]].<ref name="Insider 147" />

===Jedi Order===
{{Main|Jedi historian}}
Within the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], some [[Historian/Legends|historians]] bore the title of [[Jedi historian|Chronicler]]. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Dorak]] was one such individual, holding the position during both the [[Mandalorian Wars]] and the [[Jedi Civil War]].<ref name="KOTOR" />
